Medicus Suite v3.240.0 — Companion HUD test build
=================================================

Temporary Load-unpacked test zip for PR #322. Drop this dist/ folder before
merge — it is not a GitHub Release.

1. Download medicus-suite-v3.240.0-companion-test.zip and unzip it
   somewhere permanent.
2. Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode (top right).
3. If you already have Medicus Suite loaded (shared folder or an older
   unpacked build), turn that card OFF so two copies do not run at once.
4. Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped
   medicus-suite-v3.240.0-companion-test folder (the one that contains
   manifest.json).
5. Pin the extension. Open a live Medicus task overview.
6. The floating box should say Companion. Click Clinic / Reception /
   Triage / Nursing. Then try a care-record page and the medical queue.

SHA-256: 85afd62ec66a9be624ee12936cb5acb7697f0f78faacba50e3c32e84ca11ceb1
